facts.where: section "What we did"
facts.quote: Every request went through OpenRouter, pinned to one host per model with fallback to other hosts turned off: OpenAI for GPT models, Anthropic for Claude, Moonshot AI for Kimi and Together for both DeepSeek versions.
facts.note: OpenRouter with one host pinned per model (fallback off): OpenAI for GPT, Anthropic for Claude, Moonshot AI for Kimi, Together for both DeepSeek versions; Gemini 4 Hydrogen pinned to Google (Nov 14 run); the Nov 8 harder-task rows did not pin hosts (GPT requests served by OpenAI, Claude requests by Claude Platform on AWS)

facts.where: section "What we did"
facts.quote: Each request asked for low reasoning effort with a 3,072-token output cap, the September settings.
facts.note: requested on every request; "the same low effort label does not mean equal thinking time across providers" (the page)

facts.where: section "What we did"
facts.quote: Each model tried every task five times, and the model order reversed on every second attempt.

facts.value: Fixed code checks graded every answer.
facts.where: section "What we did"
facts.quote: Fixed code checks graded every answer. We did not repair answers, re-ask after a wrong answer, or use a model judge.
facts.note: the page also says the run and grading were done by Claude for Kingy (a fixed script grades)

facts.where: section "The short answer"
